observations.behavior: Adds a check to reject incremental configuration in resource_defaults.endpoint, requiring it to be set per-resource instead.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents a configuration error where a shared default endpoint could bypass per-resource incremental settings, potentially causing incorrect full-scans or cursor handling. The check is added to the manifest validation for warehouse sources.
